```{r load-visium-008}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 16000 * 1024^2)
# data set taken from https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/visium-hd-cytassist-gene-expression-human-tonsil-fresh-frozen-if
# but this was low yield. not a lot of germinal centers and just could not cluster out the Tfh
# will switch instead to alternative:  https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/visium-hd-cytassist-gene-expression-human-tonsil-fresh-frozen

hires_img <- Read10X_Image(image.dir = "visium-tonsil-notIF/binned_outputs/square_008um/spatial", image.name = "tissue_hires_image.png")
lores_img <- Read10X_Image(image.dir = "visium-tonsil-notIF/binned_outputs/square_008um/spatial", image.name = "tissue_lowres_image.png")

data_dir <- "visium-tonsil-notIF/binned_outputs/square_008um/"
tonsil <- Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = data_dir, filename = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", assay = "Spatial")
tonsil <- subset(tonsil, subset = nCount_Spatial > 0)
raw_counts <- GetAssayData(tonsil, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")
selected_genes <- rownames(raw_counts)[Matrix::rowSums(raw_counts) > 3]
tonsil <- subset(tonsil, features = selected_genes)
tonsil <- SCTransform(tonsil, assay = "Spatial", verbose = TRUE, vst.flavor = "v2", conserve.memory = TRUE)
spatial_genes <- c("GNG4", "BCL6", "CXCL13")
a <- SpatialFeaturePlot(tonsil, features = spatial_genes, ncol = 3, pt.size.factor = 10, 
  alpha = c(0.1, 1) ) ;  a
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = "output.pdf")
tonsil <- RunPCA(tonsil, assay = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)
tonsil <- FindNeighbors(tonsil, dims = 1:30)
tonsil <- FindClusters(tonsil, resolution = 0.5)
tonsil <- RunUMAP(tonsil, dims = 1:30)

cluster_path <- "visium-tonsil-notIF/binned_outputs/square_008um/analysis/clustering/gene_expression_graphclust/clusters.csv"
graph_clusters <- read.csv(cluster_path)
rownames(graph_clusters) <- graph_clusters$Barcode
tonsil <- AddMetaData(  object = tonsil, metadata = graph_clusters["Cluster"], col.name = "Loupe_GraphClust" )

# qs2::qs_save(tonsil, file = "visium-tonsil_08um.qs2", nthreads = 4)
# tonsil <- qs2::qs_read(file = "visium-tonsil_08um.qs2", nthreads = 4)
```

```{r FindAnchors-tfh}

tfh <- qs2::qs_read(file = "tfh.qs2", nthreads = 5)  # import HBV dataset
table(Idents(tfh))
DefaultAssay(tfh) <- "SCT"
DefaultAssay(CD4.cells) <- "SCT" 

DefaultAssay(tfh) <- "RNA"       # Assuming 'RNA' is the raw assay name in your scRNA obj
DefaultAssay(CD4.cells) <- "Spatial"
tfh <- NormalizeData(tfh)
CD4.cells <- NormalizeData(CD4.cells)

tfh <- FindVariableFeatures(tfh, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

 # First start by applying Tfh subsets signatures to all CD4...
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(  reference = tfh, query = CD4.cells, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", reduction = "cca", dims = 1:30)

Reductions(CD4.cells)

predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = Idents(tfh), weight.reduction = CD4.cells[["pca"]], dims = 1:30 )

CD4.cells <- AddMetaData(CD4.cells, metadata = predictions)
tail(colnames(CD4.cells@meta.data), 15)

md <- as.data.table(CD4.cells@meta.data)

DefaultAssay(CD4.cells) <- "SCT"

features_to_plot <- c("prediction.score.GNG4.subset", "prediction.score.TNFR2.subset", "prediction.score.GPR183.subset",
  "prediction.score.VIM.subset", "prediction.score.HSP.subset", "prediction.score.IL7R.subset")
a <- SpatialFeaturePlot(object = CD4.cells, features = features_to_plot, ncol = 3, pt.size.factor = 10, alpha = c(0.1, 1) ); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4-tfhSubsets-img.pdf', width=20, height=12)
# 
# qs2::qs_save(CD4.cells, file = "CD4_labeltsfr_Tonsil_08um.qs2", nthreads = 4)
# CD4.cells <- qs2::qs_read(file = "CD4_labeltsfr_Tonsil_08um.qs2", nthreads = 4)

subset.cols <- c(
  "GNG4 subset"   = "mediumaquamarine", # Mature GC-Tfh
  "HSP subset"    = "darkorange3",      # Stressed/Early (The darker orange you requested)
  "IL7R subset"   = "salmon",           # Quiescent/Memory-like
  "GPR183 subset" = "thistle",          # Transitional/Outer-follicle
  "VIM subset"    = "yellowgreen",      # Highly active/Invasive
  "TNFR2 subset"  = "skyblue"           # Early Activation/Starter
)

tonsil$Loupe_GraphClust <- as.factor(tonsil$Loupe_GraphClust)
colpalette <- DiscretePalette(n = length(levels(tonsil$Loupe_GraphClust)), 
                              palette = "alphabet2")
names(colpalette) <- levels(tonsil$Loupe_GraphClust)
a <- SpatialDimPlot(tonsil, group.by = 'Loupe_GraphClust', pt.size.factor = 5, 
                    cols = colpalette ); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_tonsil-Regions-img.pdf', width=8, height=8)
a <- VlnPlot(object = CD4.cells, features = features_to_plot, group.by = 'Loupe_GraphClust', pt.size = 0.1, alpha=0.1, same.y.lims = T); a;
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4-tfhSubsets-Vln.pdf', width=20, height=12)

clust8 <- as.data.table(md)[Loupe_GraphClust == 8]
clust8.compos <- clust8[, .(count = .N), by=predicted.id][, percent := (count / sum(count)) * 100]
a <- ggplot(clust8.compos, aes(x = reorder(predicted.id, -percent), y = percent, fill = predicted.id)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Tfh Subsets in Cluster 8", x = "Predicted Tfh Subset",y = "Percentage (%)",) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none',axis.title.x = element_blank()); a 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4-tfhSubsets-clust8.pdf', width=4)
a <- ggplot(clust8.compos, aes(x = "Region 8", y = percent, fill = predicted.id)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) + 
  theme_minimal() + scale_fill_manual(values = subset.cols) +
  labs(title = "Cluster 8", y = "Percentage (%)", fill = "Tfh Subset") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(color='black')) ; a
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4-tfhSubsets-clust8-stacked.pdf', width = 2.5, height=3)

# a <- ggplot(cxcr5_expr, aes(x = V1)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.1) + theme_classic(); a;  ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'output.pdf')
cxcr5.expr <-  GetAssayData(CD4.cells, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")["CXCR5", ] 
CD4.cells <- AddMetaData(CD4.cells, metadata = cxcr5.expr, col.name = 'CXCR5.expr')

CD4.tfh <- subset(CD4.cells, CXCR5.expr > 0)

features_to_plot <- c("prediction.score.GNG4.subset", "prediction.score.TNFR2.subset", "prediction.score.GPR183.subset",
  "prediction.score.VIM.subset", "prediction.score.HSP.subset", "prediction.score.IL7R.subset")
a <- SpatialFeaturePlot(object =  subset(CD4.tfh, prediction.score.max>0.5 ), features = features_to_plot, ncol = 3, pt.size.factor = 30, alpha = c(0.1, 1) ) & scale_fill_viridis(option = "inferno"); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4tfh-tfhSubsets-img.pdf', width=20, height=12)

print(GetTissueCoordinates(CD4.tfh, scale = "hires") %>% summary )
zoom1_xlim <- c(3200,3800);  zoom1_ylim <- c(1600, 2300)
coords_segm_zoom1 <- GetTissueCoordinates(CD4.tfh, scale = "hires") %>% 
  filter(x>zoom1_xlim[1], x <= zoom1_xlim[2], y > zoom1_ylim[1], y<=zoom1_ylim[2])
CD4.tfh.zoom <- subset(CD4.tfh, cells = coords_segm_zoom1$cell )
CD4.tfh.zoom <- subset(CD4.tfh.zoom, prediction.score.max>0.5 )

a <- SpatialDimPlot(CD4.tfh.zoom, pt.size.factor = 0); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4tfh-HandE-img.zoom.pdf', width=20, height=12)

a <- SpatialFeaturePlot(object = CD4.tfh.zoom, features = features_to_plot, ncol = 3, pt.size.factor = 30, alpha = c(0.1, 1) ) & 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "inferno"); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4tfh-tfhSubsets-img.zoom.pdf', width=20, height=12)



 
# CD4.tfh@images$slice1 <- lores_img
# CD4.tfh.zoom@images$slice1 <- lores_img
a <- SpatialDimPlot(CD4.tfh, images = "slice1", pt.size.factor = 0)  + coord_fixed(xlim = c(3200, 3800), ylim = c(1600, 2300)) + theme(legend.position = 'none'); a; 
# ggsave(plot = a, filename = 'Images/Visium_CD4tfh-HandE-img.zoom.pdf', width=20, height=12)

# qs2::qs_save(t, file = "Tfh_Tonsil_08um_labeltsfr.qs2", nthreads = 4)

sessionInfo()
```
